source: Director Brief, Measuring impact; BRD Section 8; stage grouping from the Director Brief chart 'KPIs by lifecycle stage'. Renumbered on 15 October 2026: 28 KPIs (two per governing document); the three merged policies keep two further measures each as supporting measures (supporting: true, ids KPI-DPxx-S1 and -S2), tracked but not reported to leadership and not counted in the 28.

stages.name: Collect
stages.question: Is new data born clean and documented?

stages.name: Store and move
stages.question: Does data arrive whole and keep its history?

stages.name: Fix at source
stages.question: Are errors fixed at source, and how fast?

stages.name: Classify and protect
stages.question: Do we know what we hold, and is it safe?

stages.name: Use and share
stages.question: Does the right data reach the right people?

stages.name: Retain
stages.question: Can we reproduce any past figure?

kpis.name: DS&A instructions acknowledged by Digital Excellence within 2 working days
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: correctionInstructions where sentAt in period and acknowledgedAt <= ackDueAt (2 working days after sentAt)
kpis.denominator: correctionInstructions where ackDueAt in period (acknowledged, declined or still open)

kpis.name: Items escalated past 15 working days without a decision
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.formula: count of escalations that reached level director_general (Group unresolved for 15 working days) with referredToDgAt in period

kpis.name: Inventory fields classified and approved, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Classifications of DX Hub datasets submitted to the DDSE, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: datasets whose externalExchanges include 'DX Hub', with classificationStatus approved or submitted_ddse, and ddseSubmittedAt set
kpis.denominator: datasets whose externalExchanges include 'DX Hub', with classificationStatus approved or submitted_ddse

kpis.name: Requests decided within 15 working days, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: sharingRequests with decidedAt in period and workingDays(receivedAt, decidedAt) <= 15

kpis.name: Daily pushes passing reconciliation, %
kpis.dataSource: Digital Excellence feed or DS&A entry [confirm]
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Share of decisions escalated to the Director General (should fall)
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: sharingRequests decided in period with decidedBy = dg_office

kpis.name: Failed pushes fixed within 1 working day, %
kpis.dataSource: Digital Excellence feed or DS&A entry [confirm]
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Requests delivered within their priority tier target, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: serviceRequests with deliveredAt in period and deliveredAt <= targetDate
kpis.denominator: serviceRequests with deliveredAt in period and a targetDate

kpis.name: Extracts delivered by Digital Excellence within 5 or 10 working days, %
kpis.dataSource: M1 redirected extracts, or the Digital Excellence service desk [confirm]
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.confirm: whether the Digital Excellence service desk stays the system of record

kpis.name: Incidents contained within 1 working day, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: dataIncidents reported in period with containedAt <= 1 working day after reportedAt

kpis.name: Collection forms with a transparency notice and consent, %
kpis.dataSource: M6 go-live checklist; DS&A entry for existing forms [confirm]
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Strategic KPIs that are measurable, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: kpiCatalogEntries of type strategic with state adopted
kpis.denominator: kpiCatalogEntries of type strategic with state adopted or parked

kpis.name: Published operational figures matching the owner's certified data, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: channel values (website, DX Hub, Education Directory) equal to the certified value, for statistics of the period
kpis.denominator: channel values recorded for statistics of the period
kpis.note: The BRD lists this KPI as 'Published figures matching certified data, %' measured on DS&A; the Director Brief title and owner are used here.

kpis.name: Published-data issues open past service level
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.formula: count of dqIssues with publishedData = true, not closed, and dueAt before period end

kpis.name: KPI source data delivered on the agreed date, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: catalog deliveries with agreedDate in period and deliveredAt <= agreedDate
kpis.denominator: catalog deliveries with agreedDate in period

kpis.name: Quality score of critical data elements, by dimension
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.note: Seeded with a breakdown by dimension (Completeness, Uniqueness, Timeliness, Accuracy, Consistency, Reconciliation, Validity). Interpretability, Relevance and Availability (DDM-008) are listed in spec/dq_dimensions.json and show no value until their method and threshold are decided.

kpis.name: Institution issues corrected within 20 working days, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: remediationItems with correctionDueAt in period and correctedAt <= correctionDueAt

kpis.name: Manual collections with an approved digitization request, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: manualCollections whose digitization state is solution_given or later (Digital Excellence gave a solution, estimate and date)
kpis.denominator: manualCollections registered and not closed before the period
kpis.decide: is 'solution, estimate and delivery date given' the right meaning of approved?

kpis.name: New fields with definition and business rules before go-live, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: fieldChangeRequests of type add with goLiveAt in period and definitionRecordedAt < goLiveAt
kpis.denominator: fieldChangeRequests of type add with goLiveAt in period

kpis.name: Surveys registered with full metadata before launch, %
kpis.dataSource: M7 survey register; NG survey feed [confirm]
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: surveys with liveDate in period, registeredAt < liveDate and metadataComplete

kpis.name: Source systems feeding the warehouse or DS&A environment on schedule, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Snapshots captured within 1 working day of the scheduled date, %

kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Disposals carried out with evidence, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Tool requests fulfilled within service level, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.decide: do the DP-09 KPIs stay after the DP-09 rescope? (BRD open question 19)

kpis.name: DS&A models validated before use, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: models in use with validatedAt before firstUseAt
kpis.decide: add a model register for DP-09 11.2 so this KPI can be computed

kpis.name: Critical data elements with full metadata, %
kpis.dataSource: M7 Data Inventory; data dictionary [confirm location]
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Loads passing source-to-refined reconciliation, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Dashboards in use that are certified, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Project access for PRP and QAC granted within service level, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.denominator: accessRequests of type project granted in period

kpis.name: Critical data elements meeting every sub-dimension threshold, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]

kpis.name: Services with an agreed timeliness commitment, %
kpis.targetNote: Baseline in the first quarter after launch, then targets [confirm]
kpis.numerator: timelinessCommitments (service rows) with status approved or measuring
